description:
Receivo is invoicing software for small businesses and trades. Connect your Receivo account to ask about your business in plain words: which invoices are overdue and by how much, what you were paid this month, or what is on a particular invoice.

If you allow it when connecting, ChatGPT can also add new clients and create invoices for you. Invoices are always saved as drafts: nothing is sent to your client and no payment is requested until you review it and send it yourself in Receivo.

The plugin only ever sees your own Receivo account, with the same permissions you have when you sign in. It cannot send invoices, email clients, take or move payments, change your plan, or edit or delete anything. You can disconnect at any time in Receivo under Settings, AI Connections.

defaultPrompt: Which of my invoices are overdue, and how much am I owed in total?
How much did I get paid this month?
Create a draft invoice for one of my clients.
